requirements: At least 100 independent training events and 100 heldout events
Point-in-time executable books and independent evidence with verified final labels
Heldout calibration, confidence-bounded improvement and cost-adjusted edge
Explicit provenance review and separate actor approval; no automatic promotion

counter_scope.phase10_epoch: Cumulative since explicit trace epoch; persisted across restart; legacy counts retained separately
counter_scope.latest_cycle: Latest engine evaluation plus subsequent admission/execution events; replaced on each evaluation; service health reports later cycle failures
counter_scope.strategy_id: Each strategy has independent counters; rejected reasons are nonexclusive and do not sum to rejected signals
counter_scope.candidate_signals: Data/evidence prerequisites passed with a numerical valuation; cost/risk can still reject
counter_scope.qualified_opportunities: Strategy admission predicates passed before portfolio risk
counter_scope.order_attempts: A paper order intent was created and presented to risk; not all qualified opportunities create an intent
counter_scope.fills: New simulated execution fill events including partials; entries/exits reported separately

quote_selection: Selected experimental tokens with fresh source timestamps and ask between .1 and .9; quote only, not a qualified opportunity or fill
